notes.title: Price Drop, Legacy Gifts, Procedural Maps, New Mechanics, New Enemies
notes.content:
Hey Gang! Some of you might have noticed that we've been quietly pumping out a lot of changes the past month. The changes were happening so often that I figured to just save it all for one big post. This one's a [b]Whopper[/b] so get ready ;]

[h1]
We've been listening, boo! (｡•̀ᴗ-)✧
[list]
    [*]Game Price has Dropped
    [*]Legacy Supporters Gifted all future DLC's (Thanks for your early support guys! I got to eat real food <3)
    [*]All Levels are now [b]Procedurally Generated[/b] (Weapon Table Spawns with the Player)
    [*]Bullet Decals and Particles now Effectively Applies
    [*]Critical Damage Now Properly Applies (50Cal receives a higher modifier)
    [*]All enemies behavior patterns & attributes have been altered
    [*]Replaced majority of meshes & added substantial animations to their respective types
    [*]New Mechanics: [b]Feint[/b], [b]Flow[/b], [b]I-Frames[/b], & [b]Modifiers[/b]
    [*]Mobility & Understanding of [b]F&F[/b] (Feint & Flow) is Crucial for survival

[/list]
[/h1]



[h1][b]New Mechanic: Feint & Flow[/b][/h1]
[b]Flow[/b]
[list]
    [*][b]Crouch[/b]
    [*][b]Powerslide[/b] (Sprint + Crouch - 3 Sec reset shared with Dive)
    [*][b]Dive[/b] (Sprint + Jump + Crouch - 3 Sec reset)
    [*]Low Openings can be accessed through an aimed Powerslide
    [*]High Openings can be accessed through a Double-Jump Dive
    [*]Disabled Wallrun - Maps are too small atm & Procedural Design is Unstable
[/list]
[b]Feint[/b]
[list]
    [*][b]Crouches[/b] will dodge [b]Horizontal[/b] Swings
    [*][b]Jumps[/b] will dodge [b]Low[/b] Swipes
    [*][b]Strafes[/b] will dodge [b]Vertical[/b] Swings 
    [*]All Enemies have an attack window from Initiation to Damage Application, which can easily be (individually) Kited by simply [b]Backstepping[/b] or [b]Strafing[/b]. This is [b]Different[/b] from I-Frames (see next)
[/list]

[h1][b]New Mechanic: I-Frames (Invincibility Frames)[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]There is a small I-Frame [b]Window[/b] during your Dive & Slide where players are immune to all damage
    [*]A Properly Timed I-Frame will [b]Ignore[/b] all Status Effects (e.g. Banshee's Scream)
    [*]Some enemy types & modifiers possess this same mechanic
[/list]

[h1][b]New Mechanic: Enemy Modifiers[/b][/h1] (Varied Probability to activate on Spawn based on Type)
[list]
    [*][b]Charred[/b] (On Fire) - Health & Damage Increased
    [*][b]Jacked[/b] (Halloween Update) - +Health & Immunity to Critical Damage
    [*][b]Chameleon[/b] - Permanently Invisible
    [*][b]Aegis[/b] - Vulnerable Only to Headshots
    [*][b]Feedback[/b] - Causes Return Damage to players within Range (Electrical Sparks)
[/list]

[h1][b]Replaced/Added Unique Models:[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]Tank[/b]
    [*][b]Runner[/b]
    [*][b]Melder[/b]
    [*][b]Blinker[/b]
[/list]

[h1][b]New Enemy Types:[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]Crawler[/b] - Low Frame & Small Knockback
    [*][b]Caustic[/b] - Low Frame, Fast, & Explodes upon Death/Proximity
    [*][b]Banshee[/b] - Stationary & Slows Movement
[/list]




[b]Note:[/b] The change to procedural levels & large number of new enemy types will require a substantial amount of rebalancing.
Since small adjustments have and will occur on a daily basis, I won't post any changes unless they are substantial.

[h1]The [b]Banshee[/b] & [b]Blinker[/b] are both extremely difficult additions (on purpose), even for us developers σ(≧ε≦ｏ), so watch out for them! Remember that a lot of the stronger enemies have key weaknesses.[/h1]

[b]Working On: [/b]
[list]
    [*]Ammo, Currency, Experience, Upgrades
    [*]Lost Dahlia (Card Modifier Meta-Game)
[/list]

notes.title: (≡人≡；) Halloween Update & Discount
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26415273/6578a79c2a17459f62f638dd07a0fc7916222bc2.png[/img]

m(_ _)m... sorry gang, got insanely ill. no excuses, gonna grind to pump out as much as we can. Steam's pending the [b]50% Halloween discount[/b] right now. We're excited since the team's growing and we can finally start releasing what we always wanted to feature.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26415273/c558f1f95bb3bd6c08febea534680d9ce144ac89.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26415273/d4dbb0acf97804d4b56b843766043509733f218f.png[/img]

So, uh. an explanation, as its simply unacceptable that we haven't been able to release these updates on schedule. I haven't been sick for a decade. Vomit-free since 06 etc, those fun adolescent days. I've also been traveling to meet with investors around the world. Still not sick. So what got me? LAX's return flight. My fellow Californians doused me with some mutant-suicide bug that apparently no exotic bacteria could do. o(_ _;o)


I've been releasing small packet patches here and there, but really until a few days ago I haven't been able to do anything outside generate monotonous moans like an emo teen post heartbreak.

Anyways! Enough of that. Nose to the grindstone. 
Thanks for the patience guys! o(≧∇≦o)
